faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Straight answers about MyChatCRM and WhatsApp operations.

items.q: Does MyChatCRM use the official WhatsApp API?
items.a: Yes. We work with Meta's official API (WhatsApp Business), ensuring deliverability, security and compliance with platform policies.

items.q: Do I need technical knowledge to use it?
items.a: No. The panel is intuitive and our team handles initial setup, integrations and AI training for your segment.
We collect your business information, materials and common objections. Then we adjust prompts, tone of voice and flows until the AI performs to your standard.
Yes. Plans are monthly and you can request cancellation according to the contract terms, no fine print.

items.q: Does the bot respond to customer audio messages?
items.a: Yes. The assistant interprets received audio and can reply in text or audio, with configurable voices.

items.q: Does it work for any type of business?
items.a: We serve various segments. Performance depends on conversation volume and the quality of information provided in training — and we help you with that.

items.q: How many WhatsApp numbers can I connect?
items.a: All plans include 1 number on Meta's official API. You can add more numbers: each extra costs R$ 75/month, added to the subscription.

items.q: How does Google Calendar integration work?
items.a: We connect via OAuth, sync events and can send WhatsApp reminders according to rules you define.
